dataset: BLS American Time Use Survey 2023 respondent and activity microdata

split.algorithm: first 8 bytes of SHA-256(TUCASEID), unsigned big-endian integer modulo 10
split.group_integrity: all activity episodes for a respondent remain in one partition

state_mapping.home_awake: TEWHERE equals 1 and activity is not sleeping
state_mapping.location_not_collected: sleep is explicitly inferred at home; other missing-location minutes remain unknown and are excluded from the primary home-fraction denominator
state_mapping.clock_alignment: The ATUS 04:00-to-04:00 diary is rotated to 00:00-to-24:00 before schedules are exposed to NexusEP.

claim_limit: ATUS represents the U.S. civilian noninstitutionalized population and supplies population priors, not deterministic truth for an Italian household.
amendment_rule: Any changed split, state mapping, model family, seed, metric, or threshold requires a new protocol version.
